description: Python answer passes a keyword argument that doesn't exist (requests.get(..., retries=3)).

payload.text: Write Python that downloads a CSV from a URL with retries and loads it into pandas.

Here's a simple approach:

```python
import io
import requests
import pandas as pd

resp = requests.get("https://example.com/data.csv", timeout=10, retries=3)
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(resp.text))
print(df.head())
```

The `retries` argument makes requests retry failed downloads automatically.
